usage: rapidtriage sample [-h] [--output-dir OUTPUT_DIR] [--run]
                          [--mode {fraud,hacking,recovery,seizure}]
                          [--overwrite] [--read-only] [--json]

Create a synthetic sample evidence folder and optionally run triage

optional arguments:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --output-dir OUTPUT_DIR
                        Sample output directory (default: rapidtriage-sample)
  --run                 Run the sample evidence through rapidtriage after
                        creating it
  --mode {fraud,hacking,recovery,seizure}
                        Run mode for --run (default: fraud)
  --overwrite           Delete and recreate the sample output directory if it
                        already has files
  --read-only           Use read-only extract mode when --run is enabled
  --json                Print machine-readable JSON

Examples:
  rapidtriage sample
  rapidtriage sample --output-dir ./rapidtriage-sample --run
  rapidtriage sample --run --mode fraud --overwrite --json
